PROBLEM. CI failed because /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/gap_rules.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/situation_trace.py default their `--root` to an absolute path on one developer's machine (`/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/data/stories/...`). /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/gap_rules.py even builds the story folder name from character codes. On the CI runner that path does not exist, so `main([...])` returns 2 and `tests/test_gap_rules.py::test_script_main_returns_zero_with_flags_and_two_for_unknown_anchor` fails.

FIX. Make both scripts derive the default root from the script's own location, exactly as /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/impact_report.py does: `_STORIES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "stories"` and `DEFAULT_ROOT = next(path for path in sorted(_STORIES.iterdir()) if path.is_dir())`. Remove the character-code name construction and any story name from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/gap_rules.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/situation_trace.py. Change nothing else in them (argument parsing, exit codes and output stay exactly as they are).

GUARD TEST in /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_story_review_scripts.py: for each of scripts/gap_rules.py, scripts/situation_trace.py, scripts/impact_report.py and scripts/branch_report.py, import the module by path (importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, so no packaging is needed), assert its `DEFAULT_ROOT` is an existing directory that lies under the repository root computed from the test file's own location (`Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]`), and assert the script's source text contains no `/home/` substring. A fifth assertion: running each script's `main` with an unknown anchor and its default root returns 2 (not an exception). Keep it hermetic and fast. Existing tests /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_gap_rules.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py must still pass.

HOW TO RUN (from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge): `export TMPDIR=/tmp PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_story_review_scripts.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_gap_rules.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_situation_trace.py -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | tail -15`. Format and lint: `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/gap_rules.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/situation_trace.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_story_review_scripts.py && /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/gap_rules.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/situation_trace.py /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_story_review_scripts.py` (if ruff format cannot write because the filesystem is read-only, run `ruff format --check` and say so).
